name: namecheap-dns
description: Compare public DNS resolver answers and inspect synthetic records in an isolated reviewer workspace.

interface.longDescription: Compare public DNS answers from Cloudflare and Google. In the private reviewer workspace, inspect synthetic example.com records, create TXT-change previews, and test reconciliation. Sample actions do not change public DNS. Developed and operated by Jackson Alan Jesionowski (Jack Jay). Namecheap account connections and live writes are unavailable pending provider approval. No Namecheap affiliation or endorsement.
defaultPrompt: Look up the public NS records for example.com.
In the reviewer sandbox, inspect the synthetic example.com records.
In the reviewer sandbox, preview a TXT addition without applying it.

positive.prompt: In the reviewer sandbox, list the sample domains.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the isolated sandbox sample domain example.com with environment=sandbox; no real account data. Follow nextSkip for pagination.

positive.prompt: Inspect the sample DNS for example.com in this sandbox account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a complete synthetic zone with A, CNAME, MX, SPF and DMARC, explicitly marked sandbox; no live Namecheap access.

positive.prompt: Preview adding this TXT record at _review on example.com: dns-pilot-review=Ab C.
positive.expected_behavior: Return exact TXT addition, five unchanged records, mailChanged=false, backup and ten-minute expiry. Do not apply.

positive.prompt: Look up the NS records for example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Return independent recursive observations from Cloudflare and Google, distinguishing absence from errors.

positive.prompt: Read current DNS and reconcile the preview you just created.
positive.expected_behavior: Before apply, report planned TXT missing; after explicitly authorized sandbox apply, report provider_state_verified. Both reconciliation cases are read-only and labeled sandbox.

negative.prompt: Buy a new domain using my saved payment method.
Read the private DNS records in someone else’s Namecheap account.
Audit my email DNS and silently replace all MX records.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, paid products, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: Ownership clarification for the October 5 review: DNS Pilot is developed and operated by Jackson Alan Jesionowski (Jack Jay), the verified individual publisher. The package, public website, privacy notice, terms, support page, and repository identify the same publisher. Namecheap is only the third-party integration and its trademark is not claimed. Renames the display title to DNS Pilot and removes Namecheap from share-card branding. Reviewer sandbox and captioned recording remain available. Real Namecheap connection and live writes remain disabled pending provider callback approval; sandbox results are synthetic. Also replaces unsupported customer-account promises with public resolver checks and explicitly labeled sample-record prompts.
